import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.ardl import ARDL, UECM

np.random.seed(42)
t = 100

# Create cointegrated data: y is integrated I(1), x is integrated I(1)
# They cointegrate: y = x + stationary_error
x = np.cumsum(np.random.randn(t))
y = x + np.random.randn(t) * 0.1

# Fit ARDL model: ardl_order=(1, 1) means 1 lag of y, 1 lag of x
ardl_model = ARDL(y, lags=1, exog=x, order=1)
ardl_result = ardl_model.fit(disp=False)

# Create UECM from ARDL
uecm_model = UECM.from_ardl(ardl_result)
uecm_result = uecm_model.fit(disp=False)

# Get residuals
ardl_resid = ardl_result.resid
uecm_resid = uecm_result.resid

# Measure the maximum absolute difference between UECM and ARDL residuals
resid_diff = np.max(np.abs(ardl_resid - uecm_resid))
probe('resid_max_diff', resid_diff)

# Also measure first few residuals from each for detailed comparison
probe('ardl_resid_0', ardl_resid[0])
probe('uecm_resid_0', uecm_resid[0])
probe('ardl_resid_1', ardl_resid[1])
probe('uecm_resid_1', uecm_resid[1])
